name: Belief tag new (categorize untagged beliefs)
notes: Nightly: tag active beliefs that have no belief_tags yet, from the standardized vocab (configs/belief_tags.yaml), so consumers can pull them. only_untagged is a shrinking selector so the pass converges; capped at max_per_run with max_run_seconds as the watchdog. Runs in the belief-engine nightly rhythm so the night's new beliefs get tagged before morning.
